brief.objective: A French fashion house founded in Paris in 1854 as a trunk maker. Its collections include luggage, handbags, clothing, shoes and accessories.

creativeThesis: A Monogram Keepall told in three sounds of the bench: brass clicks, leather settles, the bag stands finished in raking light.
realWorldGrounding: Real LV product photo: Monogram canvas Keepall Bandouliere 50, vachetta trim, brass padlock
Brand fact from brief: Paris trunk maker since 1854
Savoir-Faire films (ref-1, ref-2): macro craft beats on a workbench

selectedGoal.title: The Workbench Keepall
selectedGoal.description: Tactile macro of the real Monogram Keepall on a trunk-maker's oak workbench: hardware, stitched vachetta trim, then the full bag. Craft heritage shown through material, not claims.
selectedGoal.style: Warm tungsten raking light, oak workbench, honey/brown/brass palette, 100mm macro, shallow depth of field, fine film grain

styleTags.openingAction: brass padlock clicks shut on the zip pulls
styleTags.pacing: three 5s macro takes, soft hard cuts

decisionEvidence.selectedReason: Directly dramatises the brief's trunk-maker heritage through real product materials and hardware, fully grounded.

referencesUsed.title: Inside the Louis Vuitton Trunk Factory: Crafting the Iconic Monogram Canvas (Asnieres)
referencesUsed.why: Workshop-floor craft footage of trunk-making at Asnieres: the hand, the tool and the material carry the story with no talent. Transferable: macro hands-on-material beats. Metrics not verified in time (null).

referencesUsed.title: Louis Vuitton Escale Twin Zone | Savoir-Faire | LOUIS VUITTON
referencesUsed.why: The brand's own Savoir-Faire series: a single object's making told in tactile macro with sound design. Transferable: one product, one material truth per shot. Metrics not verified in time (null).

creative.reason: Coherent warm tactile macro piece: the Monogram Keepall is readable and centred in every scene from frame 1, ending on a strong front-on hero. Biggest problem: the padlock in scene 2 shows garbled generated engraving, and the opening padlock motion is subtle rather than a crisp click.
creative.biggestProblem: Garbled engraving on the scene-2 padlock.
